question: Should this issue stay as the staged bundled-dashboard builtin task after the dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract land, or should it be folded into a different canonical UI/API item?
rationale: The request is coherent but depends on maintainer choices about bundled dashboard scope, widget SDK direction, and the public Gateway activity/attention contract.

options.title: Keep Staged Dashboard Builtin Task
options.body: Keep this issue open as the specific dashboard-widget task, sequenced after the dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract are accepted.

options.title: Fold Into Backend Activity Contract
options.body: Make the broader per-session activity issue own the remaining semantics and narrow this issue to presentation after that contract lands.

options.title: Redirect To External Plugin Path
options.body: If maintainers do not want bundled dashboard status widgets, defer this to an external plugin or ClawHub package once the widget SDK is ready.

recommendation.title: Keep Staged Dashboard Builtin Task
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the specific dashboard-widget task, sequenced after the dashboard foundation and per-session activity contract are accepted.
